title: Morning Offering
text:
O Jesus, through the Immaculate Heart of Mary,
I offer you my prayers, works, joys, and sufferings of this day
for all the intentions of your Sacred Heart,
in union with the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass throughout the world,
for the salvation of souls, the reparation of sins, the reunion of all Christians,
and in particular for the intentions of the Holy Father this month.
Amen.

translation.latin:
O Iesu, per Cor Immaculatum Mariae,
tibi offero orationes, actiones et passiones huius diei
in omnibus finibus Cordis tui Sanctissimi,
in unione cum Sanctissimo Sacrificio Missae per totum mundum,
pro redemptione peccatorum, in adiunctis intentionibus Sancti Patris.
Amen.

notes: The Morning Offering is a prayer said at the beginning of the day to dedicate all thoughts, words, and actions to God. It is associated with the Apostleship of Prayer, now known as the Pope's Worldwide Prayer Network, which encourages Catholics to offer their day for the intentions of the Church and the Holy Father.
